name: Cookie consent banner
description: A first-run cookie notice with actions for accepting essential-only or opening detailed preferences.

name: GDPR-style consent preferences
description: A preference panel for essential, analytics, and service-improvement categories. Preferences are stored locally in the browser.

name: Calendar and events list
description: A month-grouped list of public meetings, community events, and deadlines generated from calendar JSON.

name: Meetings index with search
description: A searchable, filterable public-meetings archive with text, body, start-date, and end-date filters.

name: Meeting detail
description: A detail view for one public meeting, including meeting metadata, agenda items, document links, and public-comment instructions.

name: User login
description: A static sign-in panel for a future resident or staff account workflow. The form intentionally does not authenticate.
